name: prd-refiner
description: Explicit PRD clarification and restructuring workflow for product managers.
skillInstructions: PRD Refiner must only start after explicit user invocation. When the skill asks for structured clarification, use Kimi Code's AskUserQuestion tool. Ask one high-impact or dependent decision alone. When supported, group 2-3 independent questions in one structured interaction; otherwise ask them sequentially. Put the recommended option first, explain one short tradeoff per option, and always allow custom input. Do not invent product decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify and restructure PRDs for people and AI
interface.longDescription: Guide product managers through explicit, structured clarification and generate an AI-ready PRD, decision log, and quality report.
